minor.issue: The 're-review on credential edits' guard treats the free-text 'profession' field (a job title like 'HR Consultant') as a credential field — editing it flips an Approved submission to Pending Review even though the *verified profession* (v2) is stored separately on the submission and is unchanged. Suggest excluding 'profession' from cred_fields (line 2207) since it's now a display-only tagline once verification is category-locked; verified_profession is the source of truth.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic 'shadow*' style props deprecation warning still fires on Expo Web. Not a regression, pre-known.

rca_of_issue: MINOR: POST /professional/profile treats the 'profession' free-text field (a display tagline like 'HR Consultant') as a credential field. When any pro-profile edit changes 'profession' from the seeded value, the credential-edit re-review guard (server.py:2206-2214) demotes the Approved submission to 'Pending Review'. Reproduction: sana initially Approved → POST /professional/profile with profession='HR' (differs from seeded 'HR Consultant') → next GET /verification/status returns status='Pending Review' + history append 're-review (credentials edited)'. Fix: drop 'profession' from cred_fields tuple (line 2207). The v2 credential system stores verified_profession on the submission itself and does not depend on the professional_profiles.profession tagline.
